text:
dana.m: Heads-up: planning a region routing merge tonight to reduce cross-region fanout. Plan: merge eu-fanout policy into eu-primary so eu-origin traffic stops spilling into apac-edge. Target window 22:00–23:00 UTC. Owners: @ben.k runs the route update, @carlos.r handles DNS/TTL steps, @elaine.s runs smoke checks. Full plan below — pls ack or flag blockers.

ben.k: Ack. I'll run the rollout. Prefer start 22:05 UTC so I can finish staging dry-run at 20:30. Will follow canary steps: 10% → 30% → 60% → 100% with verification at each step.

carlos.r: I'll pre-warm edge caches and set eu-edge TTL=30s at T-30m. Command I'll run:
```
dnsctl set-ttl eu-edge 30 --zone=redwood
cache-warm --region eu --targets=edge-01,edge-02
```
I'll also monitor DNS propagation via https://dig.eq/ and report latency.

elaine.s: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
- /health all 200
- p50/p95/p99 latency baseline vs canary
- error-rate < 0.5% across services
- auth latency, embed service checks
I'll post results after each canary step. Oncall: @sre-oncall pls standby for rollback.

dana.m: Canary plan simplified for ops runbook:
1) 22:05 — apply weights: eu=10, apac=90
2) wait 5m verify smoke
3) 22:15 — eu=30, apac=70, verify 10m
4) 22:35 — eu=60, apac=40, verify 15m
5) 22:55 — eu=100, apac=0, monitor 20m
Rollback immediate command (if errors):
```
rroute set-weights eu=0,apac=100 --policy=fanout-merge
```
If rollback, revert TTL to previous value after 15m.

ben.k: I'll label PR and run `orchestrate route` from jumpbox. Commands I'll run:
```
orchestrate route apply --policy fanout-merge --step 10 --step-delay 300
rctl status --policy fanout-merge --watch
```
I'll ping here at each step + when done.

deploy-bot: Scheduled route change requested by @ben.k for 1765001234. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-fan-in-merge. ETA 22:05 UTC. :rocket: 

maria.p: Product FYI — this may change some session affinity; no customer-facing changes expected. I'll coordinate PG notice if we hit any anomalies.

sre-oncall: Standby. If rollback, I'll run traffic-sink and open incident bridge. My contact: +1-555-0101.

carlos.r: One question — can we lower keepalive to 30s during canary to speed up failover? Any objections?

elaine.s: OK by me as long as we revert after 1h. Add to checklist.

ben.k: No objections. I'll include the keepalive tweak in the canary step 1.

dana.m: Cool. Final asks: everyone ack here once you have console access and post final verification at each check. Going to push the staging dry-run notes to the runbook now.

ben.k: Ack — I have console + staging tested.

carlos.r: Ack — DNS scripts ready.

elaine.s: Ack — smoke scripts ready, will post results.

maria.p: Ack — product on standby.

sre-oncall: Ack — oncall ready.
